notes.title: FACE LOVE: Face Designer coming to Steam for FREE
notes.content:
[h2][i]SURPRISE![/i] Our character-builder game [b]FACE LOVE[/b] is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3401050/FACE_LOVE_Face_Designer/]coming to Steam for FREE![/url][/h2]

[h3]There's tons of new features, like creative mode, character renaming, and [b][i]OVER 200+ FACE PARTS TO BUILD YOUR PERFECT FREAK![/i][/b][/h3]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44960524/ed8fd67269fec66313c188609ac00c8a17f83f4a.png[/img]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3401050/FACE_LOVE_Face_Designer/


[i]It's matchmaking meets sticker-book! Read the Love Profiles of your poor faceless customers, then use random wacky facial-features to assemble the perfect mug for each one![/i]

No winning or losing- just some creative cosmology for these lonesome lovebirds. 

You can save your faces to the Library, and edit them in the brand new [b]Creative Mode.[/b] Use the in-game photobooth to take screenshots to share with friends!

[h2]FACE LOVE releases on March 5. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3401050/FACE_LOVE_Face_Designer/]Wishlist today!![/url][/h2]

notes.title: Patch 2024.11.21 01

[u]Patch 2024.11.21 01[/u]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*][i](HOPEFULLY)[/i] fixes a bug where the game could save if you quit during a cutscene; resulting in some strangely locked save files

[/list]

notes.title: God Dialogue Sucking Hotfix (Patch 2024.11.16 02)
notes.content:
Hey Grovetenders!

We just pushed a hotfix to allow players to progress who weren't able to suck up dialogue from gods. Those players would fully suck up dialogue, but it wouldn't appear up in their inventory and the god would keep talking.

The bug should be much tamer for now- the inventory not popping up when you suck up dialogue from gods, even though the dialogue was successfully sucked up.

Let us know if this fix works!!

tags.bug: - The bug should be much tamer for now- the inventory not popping up when you suck up dialogue from gods, even though the dialogue was successfully sucked up.
